turns.reply:
Based on my review of the source files, here are the concrete bugs:

src/duration.js:9 — The condition `!matched || matched !== text` is flawed; when parsing "123h", matchAll splits into multiple components ("1h", "23h"), so `matched` becomes "1h23h" which never equals original text. This will incorrectly reject valid inputs or require incorrect string reconstruction logic.

src/strings.js:10 — The truncate() function uses `max - 1` in the slice, so a string of exactly length max gets truncated to one fewer character plus ellipsis. For max=5 and "hello", it returns "hell…" instead of keeping all 5 characters.

src/cart.js:3 — The applyDiscount() function applies the discount twice: `discounted * (1 - rate)` after already calculating `total * (1 - rate)`. This compounds the discount incorrectly instead of applying it once.

src/range.js:3 — The loop condition `i < end - 1` is off-by-one; to produce inclusive range from start to end, it should use `i <= end`, not `i < end - 1`.
